Strength / Buying guide

Creatine monohydrate

A straightforward checklist for comparing creatine labels.

Published November 1, 2026 · FitGear Authority editorial

Independent shopping guide. No paid rankings, hands-on testing claims, or active affiliate links.

Where to start

Compare clearly labeled creatine monohydrate products. A single-ingredient formula is easier to evaluate than a blend. This guide compares packaging and value; it does not prescribe a dose or guarantee results.

What to compare

  • Named ingredient form
  • Amount per serving
  • Number of servings
  • Independent certification

How to judge value

Calculate cost per gram of the listed creatine ingredient. Do not compare scoop sizes when one scoop also contains flavorings or other ingredients.

Before you buy

Read the current label, confirm the seller and expiration details, and check shipping and returns. Product formulas and terms can change. Discuss suitability, medications, and health concerns with a qualified healthcare professional.

Sources and further reading

NIH Office of Dietary Supplements: exercise and athletic performance. This source provides background on supplement evidence and safety; our shopping checklists are editorial guidance.
